name: [Mixed] App Performance and Reliability Concerns
description: Users are experiencing issues with app performance, including crashes, slow loading, and failed synchronizations. Some also mention difficulties in using certain features, such as managing trades, and issues with user interface and user experience.

name: [Negative] App Crashes and Performance Issues
description: Users are experiencing frequent app crashes, slow app performance, and issues with internet buffering, leading to frustrating user experience. Some users also experienced difficulties with adding money to the app, further highlighting system instability.

name: [Negative] App Crashes, Not User-Friendly, and Security Concerns
description: The app has numerous issues including crashing, unresponsiveness, confusing interface, and security concerns. Users report experiencing difficulties in navigating the app, transactions failing, and data being compromised or manipulated.
